verdict.rationale: Poke is a general AI assistant, so generating and editing images from prompts is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no image generation or image editing. The closest feature is creating tables and charts from descriptions or from shared images, which is data visualization rather than prompt-based image creation or editing, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can generate and edit images from natural-language prompts
